metadata.summary: Forschungsbau 037 is a procedurally generated research building with seven floors (Basement 1 up to Floor 5) and about 9,163 m² in total. It has 284 spaces, 227 of them rooms, and 1,780 assets. It combines offices, labs, seminar rooms and technical areas. Machines include boilers, HVAC units, 3D printers and a laser cutter. Three lifts and three staircases serve every level, and the building is step-free throughout.
key_facts: 7 floors: levels -1 to 5, each 1,308.96 m² with a height of 3.8 m
284 spaces, 227 rooms and 1,780 assets in total
Lab equipment includes 62 lab benches, 45 fume hoods, 41 oscilloscope stations and 38 microscopes
Machines: 9 boilers, 8 HVAC units, 7 3D printers and 1 laser cutter
3 lifts and 3 staircases connect all levels; the lifts are step-free
The 3 entrances are all on the ground floor
